messages:
Ana: Dropping a new mock for the billing surface 1 — two patterns: a compact spend summary card per project vs an expanded ledger panel with invoice rows. Looking for quick takes on density and discoverability.
Devon: Can you paste screenshots or frames? curious about mobile behavior.
Ana: https://figma.redwood/new-billing-v21 (frames: summary-top, ledger-bottom). Mobile stacks summary first, ledger as an expandable overlay.
Sasha: From infra side, the summary card is cheaper: single aggregated totals + metadata. Ledger needs per-line fetches and more pagination. But ledger gives clearer audit trails.
Matt: Support + finance asked for a persistent "export" affordance on the ledger. Suggest primary action = "Save as PDF" and secondary = "Export ledger CSV" right of the invoice header.
Jordan: Telemetry note: users toggle between org and project scope in-session a lot. If we bury the scope pill in a menu it reduces toggles by ~35%. We should surface it.
Ana: Two placements tested: top scope pill (compact, visible) vs left-rail scope selector (always present but farther away). Top pill wins for discoverability but collides with search.
Devon: UX tradeoff: top pill makes sense for desktop. For narrow widths use the left-rail fallback. We'll need clear focus order for keyboard navigation.
Sasha: Accessibility nit: the token denomination chips currently use 14px text on colored backgrounds and fail contrast for users with low vision. Propose increasing weight or using outlined chips for small labels. Also add aria-pressed states for scope toggle.
Matt: Copy tweak: instead of "Download", use visible label "Save as PDF" and set aria-label="Save invoice as PDF". For CSV use "Export ledger CSV" to make intent explicit.
Ana: For the compact summary: show total tokens, USD estimate, and a tiny legend (in/out tokens). Add a chevron to expand to full ledger. Default collapsed to reduce noise.
Jordan: Metrics: collapsed -> expanded conversion is ~10% historically. We should lazy-load the ledger rows on expand to save queries. Add events: billing.summary.expanded and billing.ledger.download_csv.
Sasha: Implementation: lazy endpoint GET /billing/{orgId}/invoices/{id}/lines?page=1. Also add ETag on invoice metadata so the summary can cache safely for short TTL.
Devon: Mobile behavior: summary-first, then a "View ledger" button that opens a full-screen drawer. Avoid complex tables on small screens.
Matt: Visual: when expanded highlight the top cost row with a subtle 1px accent and tooltip "Top cost driver". Add a micro-sparkline to each row showing 30-day trend.
Ana: Design nit: adjust color for token pills to use our semantic palette (brand-600 for positive costs is confusing). Use neutral-700 for labels and brand-500 for accents.
Jordan: Legal ask: invoices need a footer with tax and company legal text. Devon can we make the footer collapsible in the UI but included in PDF?
Devon: Yes, UI can collapse footer for readability; PDF generation should always include full footer. Need to check with legal on exact wording.
Sasha: Accessibility addition: announce export job start/completion via an aria-live region and add a small toast with link to the generated file. billing-bot can post a message when job completes.
Matt: Keyboard shortcut idea: Shift+B to jump to billing; inside billing use / to focus search and then use arrow keys to move scope. Power users appreciate these little touches.
Ana: Action items: I'll update Figma with top-scope pill + left-rail fallback, add compact summary variant and ledger drawer. Sasha to spec lazy-load API and ETag TTL, Jordan to draft telemetry events and basic dashboards, Matt to finalize CTA copy and footer behavior, Devon to confirm mobile drawer pattern and PDF inclusion.
Devon: I'll also check PDF renderer for long footers and multi-page ledgers.
Ana: Thanks all 1 — will push updated frames by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
